title: System commission
summary: The fee the marketplace keeps from each sale. See your rate, what you owe and what you paid.

sections.title: What is system commission?
sections.intro: The marketplace gives you a place to sell. In return, it keeps a small share of each item you sell. This share is the system commission. You pay it to the marketplace, and an admin writes down each payment.

blocks.title: In simple words
items: It is worked out when an order is placed and shown on the order.
It only counts once the order is fully paid.
If an order is cancelled or its payment is reversed, its fee is taken back.
If an item is returned and refunded, its fee comes back off your balance.
You cannot change your rate. You only read it.
Your rate is either your own rate (if the admin gave you one) or the marketplace rate for everyone.
The page tells you in a sentence, for example "The platform takes 10% of each item on an order."
A percentage is taken from each item, after the item discount. Delivery is not included.
A fixed rate is the same amount on every item line.
An item's fee is never more than what the buyer pays for that item.
A new rate only affects new orders. Old orders keep their rate.

blocks.title: An example
steps: Your rate is 10%. A buyer orders 2 birds at 3,200 each, with delivery 100.
The items add to 6,400. The buyer pays 6,500 in all.

items.means: The fee is worked out and shown. It is not counted yet.

items.term: Cancelled order reopened and still paid

items.means: All the fee from your fully paid orders.
What you still owe. It shows in amber when it is above zero.
What you already paid the marketplace.

blocks.text: Total = Due + Paid. If Due is below zero, you have a credit: you paid fee on an order that was cancelled or reversed later. The credit is used up by your next fee.

items.means: One line for each event: "System commission earned" when an order was fully paid, and "Paid to the platform" when you made a payment. Each line shows the order, the amount and your Due and Paid after it. A "Voided" grey line was taken back.
Every payment you made to the marketplace: number, date, amount and totals. Press "View" to see the admin notes and any receipt files.
Every change of your rate: when, the value before and after, who changed it and the note. Use it to check which rate applied when.

blocks.title: Good to know
items: The records list shows 20 lines at a time. Press "Load more".
You can filter by order, type, date and more.
The page also works if your account is suspended, because you may still owe money.

sections.title: How do you pay the marketplace?

blocks.title: How to
steps: Open "System commission" and read the amount in "Due".
Pay the marketplace in the way the admin team told you.
Tell the admin team that you paid, and give the proof.
The admin records your payment. "Due" goes down, "Paid" goes up, and a line appears in "My payments".

blocks.text: You cannot record a payment to the marketplace yourself. Only an admin can. Keep your receipt.

items.q: Why is my Due 0 even though I sold a lot?
items.a: Only fully paid orders count. Record the payment on each order.

items.q: Why did my Due go down without a payment?
items.a: An order was cancelled, a payment was reversed, or a return was finished. The fee came back.
No. Only the admin team can. A new rate only affects new orders.

items.q: Does the buyer see the fee?
items.a: No. Buyers never see the system commission or your share.
